routing_policy: Never combine incompatible datasets at inference time. Route each request only to a validated model whose population, outcome, prediction time, and required features match the request.

models.population: hospital encounters in the UCI diabetes dataset
models.prediction_time: using features available for the eligible encounter before outcome
models.selection_basis: selected on validation ROC-AUC with PR-AUC and Brier reviewed; final test evaluated once after selection
models.unlock_rule: Do not enable public or clinical patient probabilities until calibration is reviewed for intended use, operational alert burden is reduced to an acceptable predefined level, subgroup performance is assessed, and external validation/governance approval is completed.

models.unit_of_analysis: to be defined by approved pilot dataset
models.unlock_rule: Requires sandbox authorization, semantic mapping, local validation and governance approval.
